about.title: About this site
about.subtitle: How this public information service works, how officer contacts are verified, and your citizen rights.
about.missionText: This portal is an independent, open civic initiative designed to help residents of Uttar Pradesh identify the exact competent officers responsible for village and municipal issues. Most citizens only know their local representatives; this site maps election ballots and administrative jurisdictions to direct statutory grievance channels.
about.verificationText: All officer details, CUG mobile numbers, and jurisdiction mappings are gathered strictly from official government portals (.nic.in, .gov.in), gazettes, and published district directories. Every number displays its verification date. Numbers verified within 90 days carry a green badge; numbers checked over 90 days ago are flagged as stale.
about.privacyText: We do not store your personal details, complaint drafts, or location. All complaint letter and RTI generation takes place entirely inside your browser. No user accounts exist, and no personal identifying information is transmitted to any server.
about.portalsSubtitle: Verified .gov.in and .nic.in channels for online grievances, urban civic services, rural drinking water, and RTI filings.
about.citizenNoticeText: This platform is not owned, operated, endorsed by, or affiliated with the Government of Uttar Pradesh or any statutory body or department. It is an independent civic utility built and maintained by a citizen in the public interest to help residents locate publicly listed administrative contacts and understand formal grievance channels. All telephone numbers and jurisdictions are compiled from official public portals (.gov.in, .nic.in), and users are advised to verify critical information directly on official government websites.
about.removalText: If any contact number is obsolete, or an officially listed personal contact requires correction, please submit a report or contact the maintainers. Verified correction requests are acted upon within 48 hours.
